messages:
nina: Noticing funcall parse errors in midnight mirror run for nova-lite int4: truncated JSON when payload has deep nested arrays. About 0.9% failures.

leo: Any streaming involved?

nina: Yes, streaming responses. Repro by forcing small batch flush. Example suffix:
```
..., \"extras\": [[1,2],[3,
```
(no closing brackets)

ravi: Could be detokenizer boundary cut. Suggest adding a short post-process validator that checks for balanced brackets and UTF-8 validity before sending to client; if invalid, mark as truncated and return 502 with repair hint.

leo: I prefer returning a structured error so callers can retry with full context. Also collect token window for offline trace.

ops-bot: alert created: #canary-parse-failures > 0.5% for 5m.

nina: Action: pause canary, enable validator-only (no auto-repair), capture 10k traces, add unit test simulating last-byte truncation. Ravi will prototype validator (ETA 2h).

ravi: on it.
